changes: Added canonical host execution-readiness classification, review_host_availability_probe v2 launcher rows, reviewReadyHostCount fallback gating, and smoke coverage for Claude stream-json, Codex auth failure, agy launcher flags, and retired marker handling.
usage: Run lattice review_host_availability_probe --storyId=<story> --json to inspect executionReady/reviewReady rows, then use lattice review_escalation_status --storyId=<story> to see fallback and assurance diagnostics.
expectedOutcome: Users see host readiness based on observable noninteractive launchers, with Claude stream-json verbose, Codex auth failures, agy wrong-launcher diagnostics, and fallback refusal when two hosts are review-ready.
actualTranscript: lattice story_advance --phase=TEST passed 43/43 validation commands; lattice validate --story=B-d8ef --json passed 43/43; done_required_validate returned PASS; quorum_submit returned full-3x2 review assurance.
outcomeDiff: No difference: actual validation and diagnostics matched the expected user-visible behavior.
limitations: none - fully covered by validate, done-required validation, delivery check, and full 3x2 local quorum.
pitfalls: Codex auth-profile accounts were invalidated, so reviewer reruns used Claude CLI accounts and final assurance used Claude CLI plus Agy CLI; retired marker tests needed several reviewer tightening passes.
